system.description: Reads a person's surface emotions. The test is rolled against the target's Mental Defense; success reveals more specific thoughts. Enough raises yield one answer, possibly wrong if the target is misinformed.
system.effect: Reads a person's surface emotions. The test is rolled against the target's Mental Defense; success reveals more specific thoughts. Enough raises yield one answer, possibly wrong if the target is misinformed.
system.perRaise: A number of raises matching the target's Willpower: one question answered (only as the target believes it).
